crossRefs.note: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.
He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed…
Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

translations.web: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,
translations.bsb: Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning:
translations.kjv: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
translations.asv: And he strictly charged him, and straightway sent him out,
